title: Scaffold audio metadata service with error class
description: Create src/services/audioMetadata.ts with CorruptedAudioError, AudioMetadata type, and StorageProvider readHeaderBytes integration.
acceptanceCriteria: CorruptedAudioError extends Error with typed constructor and custom name property
extractAudioMetadata function accepts StorageProvider and object key, returns Promise<AudioMetadata>
Unit tests verify module exports CorruptedAudioError and extractAudioMetadata function

title: Implement MP3 header parsing with duration extraction
description: Add MP3 frame header parsing logic to extract duration, bitrate, sample rate, and channel topology from MP3 binary data.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses MPEG frame sync pattern and extracts bitrate index, sample rate index, and channel mode from first frame header
Computes track duration in float seconds using frame size and sample rate for CBR formats
Throws CorruptedAudioError when no valid MPEG frame sync found in first 4096 bytes

title: Implement WAV header parsing and duration extraction
description: Add WAV/RIFF header parsing to extract duration, sample rate, and channel count from WAV binary data.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses RIFF header magic bytes and validates fmt chunk presence and size field
Extracts audioFormat, channel count, sample rate, and chunk size from fmt chunk fields
Computes track duration from chunk size and audio parameters as float seconds

title: Add container format validation against MIME type
description: Add format validation comparing extracted container format against declared MIME type to detect spoofed files.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates extracted containerFormat matches declared MIME type (audio/mpeg for MP3, audio/wav for WAV)
Throws CorruptedAudioError with format mismatch details on type mismatch

title: Add integration tests for corrupted file detection
description: Add integration tests exercising the full pipeline and cover corrupted file edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test exercises full extractAudioMetadata pipeline with mock StorageProvider
Corrupted file detection covers truncated headers, empty files, and random binary data
All tests pass with vitest run command in the project root
